title: Joint platelet count and volume fail to improve cross-cycle prediction of airflow beyond flexible component effects
abstract: Adding centered platelet-count x mean-platelet-volume terms to flexible standard-measure models changed independent-cycle FEV1/FVC weighted MSE by +0.000016856 (joint bootstrap95% [-0.000016673,+0.000079792]); the registered improvement criterion was not met. Models were fitted on 3560 NHANES2007-2008 adults and evaluated on 3553 independently recruited NHANES2011-2012 adults. This negative representation test does not establish equivalence, causation or clinical utility. Previously explored same-survey cycles are not untouched external-program confirmation.
